# Ice and van incumbents

Today most stall holders use bags of ice in foam boxes, or leave stock in the van with the engine off in the shade. Ice is cheap but melts by noon and wets the produce. A few resellers rent a refrigerated van by the day, which works but costs more than a market table earns.

Nobody sells a cooling service shaped for one stall for one day.
